@comment: The fylite: terms that MORE THAN ONE host writes into an fyo document.
A term only one host writes is that page's private extension and cannot
diverge; these fourteen can, because two independent writers spell them.
The rule is one-directional and needs no list of DD names:
A term listed here MUST always carry the `fylite:` prefix.
Writing one bare claims IMAS-DD provenance the term does not have, and a
reader looking for the prefixed spelling simply does not find the field
-- no error, just a document that silently lost a section.  Not
hypothetical: `psi_norm` was written bare by app/assets/session.js and by
one block of scenario-analysis.js, while fyo.py and the OTHER block of
scenario-analysis.js wrote `fylite:psi_norm`, inside documents all typed
`fyo:equilibrium`.  No reader ever consumed the bare form.
`gated` says whether a machine can enforce the rule for that term.  A
term that is also an ordinary identifier -- `q`, `config`, `result` --
appears bare all over both hosts as a perfectly correct local name, so a
spelling check cannot bind it without drowning in false positives.  Those
are listed because they ARE part of the contract and a reader needs to
know it; they are simply not machine-checkable by spelling alone.
Generated into the browser as app/assets/fyo-names.js by rust/build.sh.
Gated by python/tests/test_fyo_vocabulary.py.

2026-08-25: `sat_rule` left this register -- only `fyo.py` writes it today, so by the scope above it is a private extension, and the reverse gate (`test_a_term_that_becomes_shared_must_be_listed`) brings it back by itself the day the browser's TGLF path writes a document. Eleven terms joined in the same pass; they had been written by both hosts and listed by neither.
2026-08-25 (merge): `equilibrium` joined when the browser's stationary loop started writing it as a block key -- the reverse gate found it, which is what that gate is for.

2026-08-26: the seven case-corpus terms (`bar` `case` `case_id` `cases` `device` `document` `initial`) joined when `fylite cases` gave the corpus a second (Python) reader beside scenario.js -- the reverse gate found them, which is what that gate is for.

2026-09-05 (第十八刀): `psi_prev` `sigma_prev` `exch_prev` `chi_turb` `r_minor` `r_major` `shift` joined — the entry march's carried state and the ladder's surface rows, written by the page's worker and by Python's model.evolve; the reverse gate found them, which is what that gate is for.

a1.gloss: Overall rotation angle [deg] of a conductor element. The DD rectangle has no tilt spelling, so EAST's tilted vessel elements carry it namespaced. Not gated: `a1` is also the ordinary field name of the in-memory element descriptor in both hosts — fyodev.js reads `fylite:a1` INTO a bare `a1`, and device.Element declares one.

a2.gloss: Angle [deg] of the element side of length `height` with the horizontal; 90 is a plain rectangle. Absent means 90, NOT 0 -- 0 would collapse the element to a line. Not gated: same as a1 — an ordinary field name of the in-memory descriptor in both hosts.

a_minor.gloss: Minor radius [m] carried on an equilibrium's global quantities, where the DD has no slot for it. Not gated: `a_minor` is also the ordinary name of that number throughout the kernel bindings and the metric ladder.

angle_deg.gloss: Poloidal angle [deg] of a magnetic probe. Carried BESIDE the DD `poloidal_angle` (rad) rather than derived from it: the conversion is lossy -- 12 of EAST's 79 probe angles do not survive degrees->radians->degrees -- and a k-file writes the degrees. Not gated: `angle_deg` is also the ordinary field name of the in-memory probe-geometry dict in both hosts.

anneal_schedule.gloss: The ridge weights of a shape anneal, one per pass, stiff → loose (`code/discharge`); absent, the kernel lays a geometric table from anneal_hi to anneal_lo over `passes`. Gated: it has no bare host-side name — both hosts spell it on the wire only.

channel_aturns.gloss: Per-BRSP-channel ampere-turns [A] of a discharge (the EFIT channel quantity, not a per-coil current), carried on the discharge section a plan binds beside the device — `code/vstab` reads the plant's currents from it, `code/discharge` a given start. Not gated: `channel_aturns` is also the ordinary parameter name of the kernel binding's channel_fold.

channel_basis.gloss: Which basis a coil-current vector is in (`amps` vs `amp_turns`, per element vs per channel). A vector read in the wrong basis is silently rescaled by the turn count, which is why this one is gated.

coil_current_units.gloss: Whether coil currents are amperes or ampere-turns, e.g. `A.turns`.

config.gloss: The input configuration a result was produced from. Not gated: ordinary local name.

control_r.gloss: R [m] of the isoflux control points (gap / strike rows) a shape design pins the boundary through (`code/discharge` · `code/pulse`); with `control_z` and `control_w`. Gated: the hosts hold control rows as objects, never under this name.

control_w.gloss: The weight of each isoflux control row relative to the boundary rows; with `control_r`. Gated: as control_r.

control_z.gloss: Z [m] of the isoflux control points; with `control_r`. Gated: as control_r.

created.gloss: ISO-8601 timestamp the document was written. Not gated: ordinary local name.

deposited.gloss: Whether a wave source actually resonated and put power in — a result, not a failure, and one a persisted document has to be able to state. Not gated: `deposited` is also an ordinary local flag in both hosts.

dvolume.gloss: dV/dpsi_N on the grid a source profile is given on, so a reader can integrate the deposition without re-deriving the metric. Not gated: it is the physics layer's own key for the same array.

equilibrium.gloss: The equilibrium block a step writes beside its own numbers — the browser's stationary loop writes `fylite:equilibrium` for step 6's re-solve account. ★It is ALSO the identifier `fyo.py` falls back to when a document has no `@id` (`doc.get('@id', 'fylite:equilibrium')`), so this one CURIE is a property on one side and an individual on the other; that is legal and it is confusing, and it is written down here rather than left to be rediscovered. Not gated: `equilibrium` is an ordinary local name in four of the browser's files.

eta_cd.gloss: Current-drive efficiency actually used by a wave source. Not gated: it is also the keyword the model entries take.

fast_energy.gloss: Stored fast-ion energy [J] of a beam deposition. Not gated: the deposition result dict spells it the same way.

flux_loop.gloss: The flux-loop readings [Wb/rad, EFIT sign] of a discharge, one per loop in the device's order, on the discharge section a reconstruction plan binds (`code/reconstruction`). Not gated: `flux_loop` is also the DD's own name for the loop array under magnetics, which both hosts spell bare there.

i_max_aturn.gloss: Per-channel ampere-turn box [A] a design may not leave (`code/breakdown` · `code/discharge` start); absent, the kernel folds it from the device's supply rating and element turns. Not gated: `i_max_aturn` is also the ordinary keyword of design.breakdown and a case-recipe argument.

impurity_density.gloss: The impurity's density [m^-3] when it is IN the quasi-neutrality (`code/evolve` with quasi = 1): the second ion channel's state, beside `fylite:ion_density`. Same AOS reason as that one. Gated: no bare use in either host.

ion_density.gloss: Main-ion density [m^-3] as one flat profile on core_profiles/profiles_1d. The DD spells ions as an AOS (ion[]/density), which a flat state row cannot carry; `code/evolve` reads it as the state its density channel resumes from and writes the one it reached (第十五刀, 2026-09-05). Gated: nothing in either host uses a bare `ion_density`.

ip.gloss: The plasma current [A] per waypoint of a pulse plan (`code/pulse`); <= 0 means no plasma at that waypoint and the currents are held. Not gated: `ip` is the ordinary name of the plasma current everywhere.

length.gloss: Effective length [m] of a magnetic probe, the span its reading averages over. The DD has no spelling for it on `b_field_pol_probe`. Not gated: `length` is an ordinary identifier in both hosts and no spelling check could bind it.

max_power.gloss: Nameplate maximum power [W] of a heating system's launcher — what the hardware may deliver, as opposed to what a shot injected. The DD's `lh_antennas` has no nameplate field, so it rides namespaced. Not gated: `max_power` is also the ordinary key of the in-memory launcher dict in both hosts.

n_parallel.gloss: The launched parallel refractive-index band (lower, upper) of an LH antenna. The DD carries only a per-shot `n_parallel_peak` signal, not the band the hardware can launch, so the band rides namespaced. Not gated: `n_parallel` is an ordinary argument and field name throughout `scenario/model/lh.py` and the kernel bindings.

n_parallel_max.gloss: Upper end of the same launched n_parallel band — see `n_parallel_min`.

n_parallel_min.gloss: Lower end of a lower-hybrid launcher's launched n_parallel band (`lh_antennas/antenna`, `code/wave`). The DD carries a peak, not a band; the band is what sets the deposition width and its uncertainty, so it rides namespaced. Written by `scenario.model.lh.deposit` and the worker's `evLhDeposit`.

name.gloss: Human-readable name of the block it sits on — a coil, a launcher, a saved case. ★Never gatable: `name` is an ordinary key seventy times over in both hosts, which is the exact false-positive class this column exists to record.

null_r.gloss: R [m] of the field nulls a shape design asks for, one per null (`code/discharge` · `code/pulse`); with `null_z`. Gated: the hosts hold nulls as point objects, never under this name.

null_z.gloss: Z [m] of the field nulls a shape design asks for, one per null (`code/discharge` · `code/pulse`); with `null_r`. Gated: as null_r.

orbit_loss_fraction.gloss: Fraction of injected beam power lost on first orbit, at the TOTAL level (the per-component block spells its own `fylite:orbit_loss`). Not gated: the deposition result dict uses the same key.

page.gloss: Which application page wrote the document. Not gated: ordinary local name.

pitch.gloss: Pitch v_par/v of the deposited fast ions on the source grid. Not gated: `pitch` is an ordinary key in the beam model and in the worker.

power_injected.gloss: Power [W] a beam PUT IN, as against `power` (absorbed) beside it. The two differ by shinethrough and orbit loss, and reading one for the other overstates the heating — gated because neither host uses the name for anything else.

pressure.gloss: A delivered pressure profile [Pa] on uniform normalised flux, the kinetic constraint of a reconstruction (`code/reconstruction`; the rows sit at `pressure_x`). Not gated: `pressure` is the ordinary name of that profile in both hosts' measurement sets.

probe_weight.gloss: The fit weight of each poloidal-field probe reading (EFIT's fwtmp2), one per probe; absent, the device's own `weight` per probe applies (`code/reconstruction`). Gated: the hosts hold it under EFIT's name (fwtmp2), never bare under this one.

psi_convention.gloss: Which flux convention the document's psi is in, e.g. `full_flux_Wb_axis_max`. Per-turn vs per-radian silently rescales every gradient term.

psi_norm.gloss: Normalised poloidal flux grid a profile is sampled on. The DD has no name for a normalised-flux coordinate, which is exactly why this is prefixed.

q.gloss: Safety factor carried OUTSIDE profiles_1d (inside it, the DD's own bare `q` is correct). Not gated: `q` is an ordinary local name in both hosts.

q_psi_norm.gloss: The psi_norm grid the safety factor is on, when it differs from the profile grid beside it.

reconstructed.gloss: The reconstructed counterpart of a truth block. Not gated: ordinary local name.

result.gloss: The result block of a session document. Not gated: ordinary local name.

rho.gloss: The transport grid [m] bound under `transport/fylite:rho` (`TRANSPORT_INPUTS`, `code/transport`) — the marched channel's own radial coordinate, which the DD spells as `rho_tor` under a profiles grid and this plan carries flat. Written by `scenario.model.transport` and the model page's transport bar. Not gated: `rho` is the ordinary variable name for a radial grid in every host and in the record's own `core_profiles/profiles_1d/grid/rho_tor`.

shinethrough.gloss: Fraction of beam power that passed straight through unabsorbed. ★The browser's beam-total block wrote `shinethrough_fraction` for this until 2026-08-25 while its own per-component block and `fyo.py` wrote `shinethrough`; one quantity, two names. Not gated: it is also the deposition result's own key.

source.gloss: The source RATE the transport operator takes, on its grid (`code/transport`, bound under transport). Not gated: `source` is the ordinary name of the array in both hosts and a DD word besides (core_sources/source).

target.gloss: The Miller target per waypoint of a pulse plan, [nt, 6] as r0 z0 a kappa delta_upper delta_lower (`code/pulse`). Not gated: `target` is the ordinary name of the requested shape in both hosts' design bars.

time.gloss: The waypoint times [s] of a pulse plan (`code/pulse`), strictly increasing. Not gated: `time` is the ordinary name of that axis in both hosts.

trapped_fraction.gloss: Trapped-particle fraction f_t at each surface.

truth.gloss: The reference answer a synthetic case was generated from. Not gated: ordinary local name.

verify.gloss: Waypoint indices of a pulse plan at which the kernel re-solves the free boundary and reports the shape obtained (`code/pulse`). Not gated: `verify` is also the ordinary field name of the page's pulse message.

vprime.gloss: dV/dρ [m²] on the transport grid — the flux-surface volume derivative the 1.5-D operator weighs its fluxes with (`code/transport`, bound under transport). Not gated: `vprime` is the ordinary name of that geometry array in both hosts.

weight.gloss: A channel's weight on a coil element, inside fylite:channel_map. Not gated: `weight` is an ordinary local name.

psi_prev.gloss: The poloidal flux [Wb] the step before a resumed block ended at, bound under inputs/evolve so the entry's Ohmic term can difference it (第十四刀, 2026-09-05). Carried by the page's entry march and by Python's model.evolve alike; the DD has no slot for a solver's lagged state, which is why it is prefixed.

sigma_prev.gloss: The parallel conductivity [S/m] the lagged step used, carried beside `psi_prev` (the Ohmic term of the next step reads both).

exch_prev.gloss: The electron-ion exchange rates [1/s] the lagged step's closure produced, carried so a resumed block's first exchange ceiling is the loop's.

chi_turb.gloss: The turbulent ion diffusivity [m^2/s] the extension's code/turbulence evaluated between two blocks of the march (第十八刀, 2026-09-05): bound under inputs/evolve for the block that follows (closure 3), and the previous answer it relaxes against; a solver's given profile, not a DD transport model, so prefixed. Not gated: the door's own raw field (`fields/chi_turb`, an entry row name like `psi`) and the readback key are bare by construction; the DOCUMENT slot under inputs/evolve is the prefixed one.

r_minor.gloss: Minor radius [m] of each traced surface on the equilibrium ladder (profiles_1d), the DD's `r_inboard`/`r_outboard` pair collapsed to the Miller half-width the kernel's surface rows read (the neoclassical and turbulent closures, the beam's shell table).

r_major.gloss: Major radius [m] of each traced surface's centre on the equilibrium ladder — the Miller `R0(r)` the surface rows read beside `r_minor`.

shift.gloss: Shafranov shift gradient dR0/dr per surface on the equilibrium ladder (the Miller row's `drmaj`), read by the neoclassical and turbulent closures. Not gated: `shift` is an ordinary local name in both hosts' geometry code.

r2_average.gloss: <R^2> [m^2] per ladder surface, the toroidal-momentum capacity's weight (第十五刀): the DD has gm1 = <1/R^2> and no <R^2>, so this row of the traced ladder is ours; code/refit states it beside the other ladder rows (第十九刀) and code/evolve's ladder tier binds it.

vprime_old.gloss: The previous ladder's dV/drho [m^2] remapped by psi_N onto the new one (第十九刀, 2026-09-05): code/refit hands it back after an alternation and the next block's FIRST step binds it under inputs/evolve (`vprime_moved`) so the moving-volume term sees the volume the equilibrium actually moved. Not gated: the door's raw output field and the readback key are bare by construction; the document slot under inputs/evolve is the prefixed one.

p_fast_third.gloss: The fast-ion pressure's trace third (p_par + 2 p_perp)/3 [Pa] on the ladder, as the beam left it at the last step (T-M12): bound under inputs/evolve for code/refit so the shape fit and the beta_p target see the same total pressure the march did (第十九刀). Not gated: a bound solver array under inputs/evolve, prefixed there by construction.

eq_x.gloss: The previous equilibrium's p(psi_N) table — its psi_N abscissa — bound under inputs/refit (第十九刀): the beta_p the last FREE solve carried, which the pressure feedback moves beta0 against (the page's evEqPressure(eqFree, geo)). Not gated: a bound solver table, prefixed under inputs/refit by construction.

eq_p.gloss: The previous equilibrium's p(psi_N) table — the pressure [Pa] — bound under inputs/refit beside eq_x (第十九刀). Not gated: a bound solver table, prefixed under inputs/refit by construction.

radii.gloss: The ladder indices the extension's code/turbulence samples TGLF at, bound under inputs/turbulence (第十八刀; the flux-match tier binds its MATCH radii there, 第二十一刀, so the closure is evaluated exactly where the root find reads it). Not gated: a bound solver array, prefixed under inputs/turbulence by construction.

q_prev.gloss: The previous stationary round's q profile, bound under inputs/evolve for code/steady_current (第二十一刀): the round's new q and psi are under-relaxed toward it (fmORelax), never on the first round. Not gated: a bound solver array under inputs/evolve, prefixed there by construction. (The flux match's own carried blob, `fylite:fm_*`, is spelled dynamically by both hosts and is not listed here — the gate lists what it can see written.)

y_init.gloss: The state a transport pass starts from, bound under transport/fylite:y_init in the panel's own unit (keV on the model page): `code/transport` steps from it, and the turbulent panel hands each pass's answer back as the next pass's start (第二十五刀). Not gated: `y_init` is also the bare local name of the same array in both hosts.

chi_prev.gloss: The previous pass's total diffusivity under transport/fylite:chi_prev — the turbulent closure relaxes the new total against it (`turb_relax`), so the page carries only the cadence between the two doors. Not gated, like `chi_turb`: the readback key is bare by construction.
